```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

generate_secreted_protein_report <- function(
    sec_prot_file,
    repo_local_dir,
    pdf_output_path,
    csv_output_path,
    gsutil_cmd = "gsutil"
) {
  required_libs <- c(
    "dplyr", "tidyr", "ComplexHeatmap", "circlize", "RColorBrewer", "grid",
    "openxlsx", "stringr", "purrr", "MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionData",
     "MotrpacHumanPreSuspension",
    "ggplot2", "forcats", "scales", "ggnewscale", "geomtextpath"
  )
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(lapply(required_libs, library, character.only = TRUE))
  
  csv_dir <- dirname(csv_output_path)
  plot_dir  <- dirname(pdf_output_path)
  
  if (!dir.exists(csv_dir)) {
    dir.create(csv_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    message(glue::glue("📂 Created csv output directory: {csv_dir}"))
  }
  
  if (!dir.exists(plot_dir)) {
    dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    message(glue::glue("📂 Created Plot output directory: {plot_dir}"))
  }
  
  # --- Step 1: Load secreted protein cell data
  secprotcell <- read.csv(sec_prot_file, check.names = FALSE)
  
  # --- Step 2: Load DA data
  df_da_full <- load_differential_analysis(
    repo_local_dir = repo_local_dir,
    selected_omes = "prot-ol",
    selected_tissues = "blood",
    single_matrix = TRUE,
    combine_with_featgene = TRUE,
    epigen = FALSE,
    gsutil = gsutil_cmd
  ) %>%
    filter(contrast_type == "exercise_with_controls")
  
  # --- Step 3: Select relevant columns
  da_sec_prot <- secprotcell %>% dplyr::select(name, "tissue label", "uniprot")
  
  # --- Step 4: Filter for significant proteins
  da_sig <- df_da_full %>%
    mutate(adj_p_value = as.numeric(adj_p_value)) %>%
    filter(adj_p_value < 0.05)
  
  # --- Step 5: Match with secreted proteins
  da_sig$in_sec_prot <- da_sig$uniprot %in% da_sec_prot$uniprot
  
  da_sig_in_sec <- da_sig %>%
    filter(in_sec_prot) %>%
    left_join(da_sec_prot, by = "uniprot")
  
  # --- Step 6: Subset mapping
  mapping <- MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionData::HUMAN_FEATURE_TO_GENE %>%
    dplyr::filter(assay == "prot-ol") %>%
    dplyr::select(feature_id, uniprot, gene_symbol) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
  
  da_sec_prot_sub_da <- merge(mapping, secprotcell, by = "uniprot") %>%
    filter(uniprot %in% da_sig$uniprot)
  
  # --- Save CSV subset
  write.csv(da_sec_prot_sub_da, csv_output_path, row.names = FALSE)
  
  # --- Step 7: Prepare data for plotting
  df_long <- da_sec_prot_sub_da %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_symbol, `Global label`) %>%
    mutate(`Global label` = as.character(`Global label`)) %>%
    separate_rows(`Global label`, sep = "\\.") %>%
    mutate(`Global label` = str_trim(`Global label`)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(`Global label` != "") %>%
    mutate(present = 1)
  
  df_wide <- df_long %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = gene_symbol,
      names_from = `Global label`,
      values_from = present,
      values_fill = 0
    )
  
  gls_data <- da_sec_prot_sub_da %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_symbol, `Gobal label score (GLS)`) %>%
    distinct(gene_symbol, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  df_final <- left_join(df_wide, gls_data, by = "gene_symbol")
  

  
  df_long_plot <- df_final %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -c(gene_symbol, `Gobal label score (GLS)`),
                 names_to = "Tissue", values_to = "Present") %>%
    filter(Present == 1) %>%
    mutate(GLS_group = paste0("GLS_", round(`Gobal label score (GLS)`))) %>%
    arrange(Tissue, desc(`Gobal label score (GLS)`)) %>%
    mutate(Gene_ID = row_number())
  
  
  
  # --- Step 8: Summarize counts per tissue
  df_prep <- df_long_plot %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      gls_score = `Gobal label score (GLS)`,
      tissue = Tissue,
      gls_group = GLS_group
    ) %>%
    mutate(tissue = factor(tissue), gls_group = factor(gls_group))

  tissue_counts <- df_prep %>%
    group_by(tissue) %>%
    summarise(assay_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(assay_count))
  
  tissue_counts$tissue <- factor(tissue_counts$tissue, levels = tissue_counts$tissue)
  
  tissue_counts <- tissue_counts %>%
    mutate(
      tissue = dplyr::recode(
        tissue,
        "adiposetissue" = "adipose tissue",
        "bonemarrow" = "bone marrow",
        "adrenalgland" = "adrenal gland",
        "bcell" = "b-cell",
        "tcellcd8" = "t-cell CD8+",
        "tcellcd4" = "t-cell CD4+"
      )
    )
  
    
  n_tissues <- nlevels(df_prep$tissue)
  tissue_palette <- scales::hue_pal()(n_tissues)
  tissue_colors <- setNames(tissue_palette, levels(df_prep$tissue))
  
  # --- Step 9: Create bar plot
  p_tissue_bar <- ggplot(tissue_counts, aes(x = tissue, y = assay_count, fill = tissue)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_text(aes(label = assay_count), vjust = -0.15, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +  # ← Count labels
    scale_fill_manual(values = tissue_colors, guide = "none") +  # Use your existing color scheme
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Number of Assays",
      title = "Tissue Annotations for DA Proteins"
    ) +
    theme(
      # axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      # plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    )
  
  # --- Step 10: Save PDF plot
  ggsave(pdf_output_path, plot = p_tissue_bar, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300,units = "in",limitsize = FALSE,device = cairo_pdf,bg = "white")
  
  message("✅ Report generated and saved successfully!")
  return(list(
    plot = p_tissue_bar,
    csv = da_sec_prot_sub_da,
    counts = tissue_counts
  ))
}
```
